title: Pure BT Standard CGM profile data source
symptom: The user asks if there is a data source option in xDrip that works with the pure Bluetooth CGM profile, as they see a service in the code but it is not listed in the settings page. They are building a custom Dexcom bridge and want to know if any existing option works with that profile.
evidence_quote: I see there is a service in the code that implements a pure CGMS profile CMGS, but it is not in the data source list on the settings page.
